2 United Coal
United Coal (UC) is a public limited company in the private sector. Most of UC’s coal is
sold to Elgen, a large electricity generating business, for fuel in power stations. Under
agreements with the Government, Elgen will have to reduce its carbon emissions. Coal is
the major cause of Elgen’s carbon emissions.
UC’s Research and Development team has developed a method of treating coal so that 5
it burns cleaner and produces less emissions. UC will need to invest in a new treatment
site that processes the coal. UC will call this product Cleancoal and this will change the
product portfolio. Coal would be transported to the treatment site from the coal fields by a
new fleet of lorries.
UC’s Finance Director has produced the following cash flow forecast for the proposed 10
Cleancoal project.
